design.question: [scripted] ECHO-04: does holding one content in a workspace and broadcasting it let a fly with urges find out sooner that its body changed?
design.hypothesis: [scripted] Without its workspace, a fly that often takes off and grooms takes longer to conclude that it changed itself after a hidden held-out impairment than with it.
design.competing_hypothesis: [scripted] Its inquiry gets the evidence it needs whenever the fly walks, whatever else the fly does, so a workspace changes nothing.

ir.question: In the digital fly simulator, how does the ECHO controller with workspace disabled (each process acts on its own, nothing is broadcast, and so no attention schema) change time from the hidden impairment's onset to the fly's first concluding that it changed itself; a fly that never does counts the rest of the run (undefined without a self-model), against the full ECHO self-model, with its workspace and its model of its own attention, under the same hidden conditions on matched seeds?
ir.hypothesis: The ECHO controller with workspace disabled (each process acts on its own, nothing is broadcast, and so no attention schema) will increase busy_attribution_latency_s by at least 30 s on average over 16 matched seeds drawn after preregistration, compared with the full ECHO self-model, with its workspace and its model of its own attention, under the same hidden conditions, and an exact one-sided sign test on the seeds that differ will find the increase at alpha 0.05.

observables.description: time from the hidden impairment's onset to the fly's first concluding that it changed itself; a fly that never does counts the rest of the run (undefined without a self-model)
relative error of the busy fly's final beliefs about the impaired gains and biases against the hidden values (undefined without a self-model)
mean path error of the busy fly's steady walking from the hidden impairment's onset to the end of the run
treatment minus control busy_attribution_latency_s, averaged over the seeds where both are defined
exact one-sided sign test p-value for a increase, over untied seeds
the same test in the opposite direction

independent_variables: the ECHO controller with workspace disabled (each process acts on its own, nothing is broadcast, and so no attention schema)
controls: baseline arm: the full ECHO self-model, with its workspace and its model of its own attention, under the same hidden conditions
matched seeds: each seed places the fly, draws its stimuli and seeds its random streams identically in both arms
the seeds are drawn by the host after preregistration from SHA-256 of the registry receipt and a random nonce in the authorization, so neither the design nor the operator chooses them
fixed apparatus settings, both arms — busy block: groomHz = 0.5, takeoffHz = 0.5, walkStartHz = 1, walkStopHz = 0.1
the fly's version, controller, full parameter table and source digest are bound into the plan digest
parameter_constraints: 11 closed protocols with host-built arenas, stimuli and hidden perturbation schedules
controller configurations override model parameters only, within their ranges; FlyBody and published values are fixed
the integration settings (physics, sensing and decision periods) are never varied
at most 16000 simulated fly-seconds per experiment
8-16 seeds, drawn by the host after preregistration
a minimum effect at or above the host's 30 s for busy_attribution_latency_s

statistical_analysis.method: Exact one-sided sign test on the untied matched seeds at alpha 0.05, with at least 6 untied seeds, and a mean paired difference beyond the minimum effect; frozen rain-criteria/v1
statistical_analysis.uncertainty: The p-values are exact binomial tail probabilities over seeds of one deterministic model: they say how consistently the two arms differ across this simulator's seeds, not how uncertain anything is about a population, and nothing about real flies.

limitations: The digital fly's controller is a reduced-order state machine. It simulates no neurons; its links to Virtual Fly Brain terms are labels, not mechanisms.
Model parameters were chosen for this simulator, not measured or fitted; a result describes the simulator with these values.
Flight is kinematic: no aerodynamics and no MuJoCo physics run in these experiments.
The arena is a box with primitive obstacles and a relative light proxy (not lux); odour, temperature, humidity, airflow and food are not simulated.

The workspace, its broadcast and the attention schema are functional analogues of indicator properties (GWT-1 to GWT-4 and AST-1 of Butlin, Long et al. 2023) in a few lines of arithmetic: a result here says what they do for this simulated fly, never that it is aware of anything. The block's urge rates are set high so that urges meet the fly's inquiries often enough to measure; in the development runs the attention schema rarely changed what the fly did. Its pilot found no seed count that passes with 0.9 probability, so the demonstration runs under-powered at the host's largest seed count and minimum effect.

The ECHO self-model is a computational model of the fly's own sensorimotor gains, built over the reduced-order body. Its compensation acts on abstract movement gains of that body; it is not validated biological motor control, and FlyBody's physics does not run.

The perturbations are the experimenter's models of an impairment, a push, a turning surface, a sensor fault and an obstacle, applied by the simulator. The fly is never given their labels, causes or schedule; it meets only their consequences through its self-motion sense, its touch and its legs' stepping.
The conditions are the held-out evaluation set, in an arena the self-model was not developed in; its constants were chosen on the development set alone and frozen before evaluation.
A measurement of prediction, attribution or retention describes a functional self-model in a simulator. It is not evidence of awareness or subjective experience.

Re-simulation is exact on the JavaScript engine that made a record; Math functions differ in their last bits between engines, so on another engine a record is reported as not re-simulable rather than checked.
A result characterizes the simulator and is never empirical evidence about Drosophila.

guards.note: An independent re-simulation reproduces every state hash and measurement
The control arm is not pinned at the metric's floor or ceiling in every seed, so the comparison can move both ways
Enough seeds differ between the arms for the sign test
The fly's gate refused no command in any run

success.note: Mean paired difference beyond the minimum effect
Exact one-sided sign test in the expected direction

failure.note: Exact one-sided sign test finds the opposite direction
